title: Answer key v1
description: The decided standard a reviewer applies to a deliverable (spec 029 B-029-2). Binary checks decided in ai-spec before the gate runs; immutable during execution, digest-bound to the spec it judges. An unknown observable is BLOCKED, never scored.

spec_digest.description: binds the spec.md bytes this key judges

unknowns.description: observables not yet specified; touching one is BLOCKED, never scored

command.description: present when judged_by is run it
